node.title: Re^5: How to share a non-blocking IO::Socket::INET server/pass "listening" control?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Since you're already working with POE, it makes sense to me to do everything with it. See the [http://poe.perl.org/?POE_Cookbook|POE Cookbook], e.g. [http://poe.perl.org/?POE_Cookbook/TCP_Clients|"TCP Clients"] for how to establish a client connection, and the example [http://poe.perl.org/?POE_Cookbook/TCP_Port_Redirection|"TCP Port Redirection"], while a bit complex, shows how to have one program be both server and client.
